evidence: A hydrophilic surface was prepared by boiling the Si wafer in a NH4OH:H2O:H2O solution (1:1:5 volume ratio) for 10 min, followed by boiling in HCl:H2O:H2O solution (1:1:6 volume ratio) for 15 min (RCA-clean). A hydrophobic surface was prepared by soaking a wafer, pre-cleaned as above, in 4% HF solution for 5 min.
